items.title: Hedge funds cut tech exposure at near-record pace as Nasdaq drops 6.4%
items.summary: Investing.com -- Hedge funds ran for the exits last week, and then the market bounced anyway. Tech was by far the most heavily net-sold sector, both globally and in the US, at a pace that roughly matched the record in Goldman Sachs prime brokerage data going back to 2016.

items.title: Goldman Sachs (GS) Stock Looks Cheap Based On Excess Returns
items.summary: Goldman Sachs Group has delivered a powerful share price run over the past few years, which now raises a sharper question for you as an investor: Is the current valuation really backed by the returns Goldman Sachs earns on the capital it puts to work in its business? Goldman Sachs Group has risen 183.2% over the past 3 years, which puts real pressure on the numbers to show that the capital invested in the firm is being put to use at sufficiently strong returns.
